title: Charred Corn Chimichurri
description: A tangy, herb-forward chimichurri folded with deeply charred sweet corn, jalapeño, shallot, lime, and a touch of smoked paprika.
ingredients: 40 g shallot, finely minced (or 40 g red onion)
2 g kosher salt, plus more to taste
steps: Char the corn aggressively in a very hot dry skillet, grill pan, or on the grill until well browned in spots. Let it cool slightly.
Combine the shallot, garlic, jalapeño, red wine vinegar, lime juice, and kosher salt. Let the mixture sit for about 5 minutes to soften and macerate the aromatics.
Stir in the parsley, optional cilantro, oregano, smoked paprika, black pepper, and olive oil.
Fold in the charred corn. Let the chimichurri rest for about 10 minutes, then taste and adjust salt or acidity before serving.
notes: Flavor target: tangy first, herby second, with sweet charred corn underneath. The corn should be deeply browned rather than merely warmed.
